routes.name: Visa-free entry (up to 3 or 8 months)
routes.summary: Citizens of 100+ countries enter without a visa. US, UK, Canada and a few others can stay up to 8 months. Most others get up to 3 months.

other: Up to 8 months: Antigua and Barbuda, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Greece, Iceland, Italy, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Norway, San Marino, Switzerland, Turkiye, UK, US.
Up to 3 months for most other listed countries, including Australia, France, Germany, Japan, Brazil, New Zealand.
Need a return or onward ticket, enough money or a local sponsor, no plan to work, and a passport valid 6 months.
Cuba, Dominican Republic, Haiti, India and Saudi Arabia have conditional exemptions. Check the official list.

stay.note: 3 or 8 months depending on passport. Extensions possible before it expires, at the Department's discretion.

steps: Check the official list for your passport.
Show a return ticket and proof of funds at the border.

routes.name: Visitor visa (prior approval)
routes.summary: Nationals not on the visa-free list need a visa before travel. They are not issued at the border.

other: Applies to nationalities like Nigeria, Pakistan, the Philippines, Thailand, Ukraine and Viet Nam, plus Macao and Taiwan ordinary passports.

steps: Apply through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs eVisa service (mofa.gov.bs) or a Bahamian consulate.
Wait for approval before you travel.

routes.name: Short-Term Work Permit
routes.summary: For a non-Bahamian who will work up to 90 days. The employer applies before the worker arrives.
steps: Employer sends a request letter to the Director of Immigration.
Submit the form with passport copy and two photos, plus the fee, at an Immigration office.
Decision is made within 7 days of a complete application.
routes.processing: Decisions within 7 days of a complete submission.

routes.name: Work Permit (stays over 90 days)
routes.summary: Needed to work and live in The Bahamas for more than 90 days. The employer usually needs a Labour Certificate and newspaper ads first.

other: Dependents apply separately for a Permit to Reside.
Validity period not confirmed on the official page, renewals look annual.

steps: Get a Labour Certificate and run newspaper ads for three days (some roles exempt).
Gather certified documents, medical and police certificates.
Submit to the Director of Immigration.
Call the Consultation Unit after 8 to 12 weeks.
routes.processing: Check status 8 to 12 weeks after submitting.

routes.name: Permanent Residence
routes.summary: Lifetime residence with the right to work but not vote. Routes include marrying a Bahamian for 5 years, investing in a home, or long legal residence or work.

other: Spouse of a Bahamian after 5 years of marriage living together.
Financially independent people or investors who own a Bahamian home. The two official pages give different minimums (BS$1.0 million held 10 years, and BS$1.5 million for faster review), so confirm.
Police, prison officers, teachers, nurses: 10 years of service. Clergy and doctors: 20 years.
Over 20 consecutive years of legal work or resident status.
Processing fee is BS$100 on one page and BS$200 on another. Confirm before paying.

steps: Fill in the application and gather medical, police and character documents.
Submit with fee to the Department of Immigration.
Call the inquiries unit after 3 to 4 weeks.
